name: Misaki Renka
source:
Suddenly appearing out of nowhere, charging headlong. Leaving behind baffling remarks or causing a ruckus, this mysterious character stirs up chaos before vanishing.

More fundamentally off-kilter than the other heroines?? (Her profession is voice actress, playing the role of “Tetsuko,” an idol admired by Koromi, a well-known figure in the industry.)

While she has her adorable moments, both in appearance and personality, but fundamentally, she has an overbearing, competitive personality.

She refuses to admit her own mistakes, declaring “I'll go my own way!” Her forceful, overbearing manner often leaves the protagonist flustered. She takes pride in calling herself a “clumsy girl.” But the truth behind that is...

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/tenmus/ren.html]official site[/url]]
